items.title: TorchRL + PettingZoo MPE in 60 Minutes
items.content_html: TL;DR: Build a reproducible multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) pipeline using TorchRL and PettingZoo's multi-agent particle environment (MPE), train using centralized training, decentralized execution (CTDE), and verify that communication is meaningful using structured diagnostics and causal ablations.

items.title: TensorFlow in 60 Minutes
items.content_html: TL;DR: Learn how to build machine learning models using TensorFlow in 60 minutes with hands-on examples including neural networks and structural time series forecasting.

items.title: FastAPI in 60 Minutes
items.content_html: TL;DR: Learn how to build a REST API with FastAPI and uvicorn in 60 minutes with hands-on examples covering request validation, dependency injection, and a complete Book Catalog API served over real HTTP

items.title: CausalML in 60 Minutes
items.content_html: TL;DR: Learn how to estimate heterogeneous treatment effects using CausalML in 60 minutes with hands-on examples including individual-level causal inference on CDC diabetes health data.

items.title: BambooAI in 60 Minutes
items.content_html: TL;DR: Learn how to build intelligent data analysis systems with BambooAI in 60 minutes with hands-on examples covering multi-agent workflows, dataframe analysis, and dynamic code generation.

items.title: AutoGen in 60 Minutes
items.content_html: TL;DR: Learn how to build agentic AI systems using AutoGen in 60 minutes with hands-on examples including live market data debates and SEC filing analysis.

items.title: UV in 30 mins
items.content_html: TL;DR uv is a very fast Python package manager written in Rust that replaces pip, pip-tools, and virtualenv with a single tool that is 10-100x faster.

items.title: llm CLI in 30 minutes
items.content_html: TL;DR: Simon Willison's llm CLI turns any large language model into a composable Unix tool you can pipe, script, and template from the terminal.

items.title: Ripgrep in 30 mins
items.content_html: TL;DR ripgrep is a blazingly fast search tool that combines the usability and speed.

items.title: mdm, a Unified Markdown Manager for Agent Skills
items.content_html: TL;DR: mdm unifies management of research ideas, blog posts, and Claude Code skills across multiple repositories into one powerful command-line tool.

items.title: LLM CLI in 30 mins
items.content_html: Transform text files with LLMs from the command line, integrate AI into your editing workflow

items.title: Python Package Tools in 30 mins
items.content_html: TL;DR: Comprehensive guide to Python package managers and virtual environment tools, from pip and venv to modern alternatives like Poetry and uv.

items.title: Python Code Coverage In 30 Mins
items.content_html: TL;DR: Python code coverage measures how much of your source code is tested, helping you improve test quality.

items.title: Rendering Markdown Files From Your Terminal with open_md.py
items.content_html: TL;DR: open_md.py is a flexible CLI tool that renders markdown files to HTML using pandoc or grip, and can open them directly on GitHub or in your browser, with support for embedded diagrams and both local and dockerized execution

items.title: How to Use OpenRouter with Simonw's LLM CLI
items.content_html: Guide on using OpenRouter with Simon Willison's LLM CLI

items.title: How to Use Claude Code with OpenRouter
items.content_html: TL;DR Learn how to configure Claude Code to route LLM calls through OpenRouter, enabling access to models from multiple providers through a single API.

items.title: Markdown Viewers on macOS: Terminal and Browser Options
items.content_html: TL;DR: Render markdown from terminal using glow (for terminal viewing), mdcat (for rich formatting), grip (for GitHub-accurate previews with images), or pandoc (for document conversion and flexibility).
